title: Static HTML artifact
question: Should a self-contained HTML file remain Doubt's primary sharing artifact?
verdict: Keep self-contained HTML as the default portable artifact and treat hosted collaboration as an optional future layer.

nodes.label: Current position
nodes.text: Keep static HTML as the default output.

nodes.label: Portable renderer
nodes.text: The CLI emits a self-contained interactive map that retains exact source regions without loading a CDN.

nodes.label: Static deployment
nodes.text: The public demo is assembled as a static Pages artifact with the map JSON, HTML, and skill discovery files.

nodes.label: Built-in interaction
nodes.text: Filtering, graph connections, and source selection all run in the generated document.

nodes.label: Counterpressure
nodes.text: A static file has no shared editing state, review permissions, or synchronized comments.

nodes.label: Qualification
nodes.text: Static-first does not prohibit a hosted layer; it keeps the durable artifact independent of that layer.

nodes.label: Missing evidence
nodes.text: No team study yet shows whether collaboration features matter more than account-free portability.

edges.note: The artifact can be archived, reviewed, or shared without a running service.
The same artifact already deploys through a minimal static workflow.
The main inspection workflow does not require a backend.
Teams may prefer shared review state over file portability.
The decision concerns the default durable output, not every future interface.
Observed team workflows should decide whether a hosted layer becomes necessary.

sources.title: Doubt README
sources.locator: Section: Quick start and rendered output
sources.excerpt: The renderer emits one interactive HTML file. Open it locally, keep it in git, or publish it as a static artifact; no account, backend, model key, CDN, or telemetry is required.

sources.title: Doubt Pages workflow
sources.excerpt: The workflow copies the site index, evidence-map HTML, map JSON, benchmark, playground, and skill discovery files into one static artifact before deploying GitHub Pages.

sources.title: Doubt HTML renderer
sources.locator: Section: Client script: selectNode, drawConnections, filters
sources.excerpt: The generated client script selects source regions, dims unrelated nodes and edges, redraws SVG connections, and filters claim, evidence, and unknown cards.
